Fun fact: In the wake of the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs, the world was a much darker and cooler place, filled with dead and decaying plants and animals, which created the perfect conditions for a different life form - fungi - to proliferate.

Scientists hypothesize that early mammals were able to step out of the shadows and fill the ecological niches vacated by the dinosaurs in part because of their much better ability to digest mushrooms and other fungi than surviving reptile species.

So in their own ways, both dinosaurs and mushrooms are integral parts of a story that winds through deep time, giving rise to the age of mammals and setting the stage for you and I to be here on Futardio today.

Jurassic Finance (@JurassicFi) is a Futardio alum bringing the first-ever tokenized dinosaur fossil onchain. MycoRealms (@mycorealms) is raising on Futardio right now to create the world’s first tokenized mushroom farm.
